# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_REJECTION_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price that opens outside the opening range and then retests VWAP with a bullish rejection candle shows institutional interest, leading to continuation. This combines the opening range breakout concept with VWAP as dynamic support/resistance and candlestick pattern confirmation to filter for higher-probability longs in low-volatility mornings.

## Mechanism

Entry: If the first 5‑minute bar’s close is outside the opening range (high‑low of first 30 min) AND within the next two 5‑minute bars price touches VWAP (±0.1%) and forms a bullish rejection candle (close > open and lower wick ≥ 0.5×body), enter long at the close of that candle. Exit: Initial stop at the rejection candle; target 1.5R; if price reaches 1R, move stop to break‑trailing stop from highest high. Regime: Best when VIX < 18 and opening range width < 0.3% of SPY price; avoid when opening range > 0.5%.
